With fixed rho_star and a true fixed beta, that is a constant NO-gap; a suitable YES codespace state must also meet completeness. The required bounded-locality B enforcing the full verification relation against arbitrary physical/coherent states is UNCONSTRUCTED. This is a sufficient conditional interface, not a complete compiler or a necessity theorem for every quantum-PCP route.
